text.tspan: Pager board (pager_main): ESP32-S3 SuperMini + 16 addressable LEDs. Generated from design_main.py. Blue labels with the same name are connected.
LED1-16: TZ-5050S2RGB-5V-I4-H1 (WS2812-compatible; VDD = VBAT 3.0-4.2 V, data 3.3 V). Each LED's DIN is the previous LED's DOUT (net LED_Dn = LEDn.DOUT -> LEDn+1.DIN); LED16 DOUT not connected.
